get_address_profile.description: See what a wallet or contract address is and what it holds: whether it is a contract, ClearTrace's guess at what kind (a treasury, a trading bot, a router), its ETH balance and its token balances.
get_address_profile.name: get_address_profile

parameters.description: The wallet or contract address (0x and 40 characters), or a block explorer link to it.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Which chain to look on.
parameters.name: chain

classification.description: ClearTrace's guess at what it is, such as eoa_wallet, router or mev_bot.

contracts_deployed.description: For a contract, how many it has created.

nonce.description: For a wallet, how many transactions it has sent.

get_address_volume.description: See how much exchange volume ClearTrace has traced through one contract or wallet, per chain, split by how it was routed: direct, through a proxy or through an aggregator. Most useful for unnamed proxies and hidden frontends; a well-known exchange is listed by name rather than address.
get_address_volume.name: get_address_volume

parameters.description: The contract or wallet address, or a block explorer link to it.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: One chain, or every chain it is on.
parameters.name: chain

aggregator_partner_volume_usd.description: Aggregator volume tagged with a partner code.

calldata_suffix_volume_usd.description: Volume carrying a frontend's tag. An overlay: already counted in the total, so don't add it on.

direct_volume_usd.description: Volume sent straight to exchange pools.

fee_transfer_volume_usd.description: Volume where a fee was paid on to this address. An overlay: already counted in the total, so don't add it on.

proxy_volume_usd.description: Volume that went through an unverified proxy first.

total_volume_usd.description: All DEX volume traced through it, in US dollars.

get_failed_transaction_rates.description: See how often each aggregator's transactions fail on chain, per chain, both overall and for regular users. By default only venues that can fairly be compared are shown: on batch-auction and intent venues an order that can't be filled never reaches the chain, so their rate is always near zero.
get_failed_transaction_rates.name: get_failed_transaction_rates

parameters.description: One chain, or all four.
parameters.name: chain

parameters.description: Only this aggregator. Leave empty for all of them.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Show only venues where the user sends the swap themselves, so the rates can be ranked against each other. Turn off to include every venue.
parameters.name: comparable_only

parameters.description: How many rows to return, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

comparable.description: Whether this rate can fairly be ranked against others.

revert_rate_pct.description: Share of its transactions that failed, in percent.

user_revert_rate_pct.description: The same, counting only senders who usually succeed: closer to what a regular user sees.

get_gas_prices.description: Get the gas price right now on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Optimism, and which is cheapest, to time a transaction or compare costs.
get_gas_prices.display_str_template: Get gas prices on every chain.
get_gas_prices.name: get_gas_prices

get_recent_trades.description: Get a sample of recent exchange trades on one chain, newest first: the tokens swapped, the dollar value, the exchange and any aggregator, the gas paid and whether it went through. The sample is small and refreshed on each data sync, not a live feed of every trade.
get_recent_trades.name: get_recent_trades

parameters.description: Which chain to sample.
parameters.name: chain

parameters.description: Only trades filled on this exchange. Leave empty for any.
parameters.name: dex

parameters.description: Only trades routed by this aggregator. Leave empty for any.
parameters.name: aggregator

parameters.description: Only trades selling this token symbol, such as USDT.
parameters.name: token_sold

parameters.description: Only trades buying this token symbol, such as WETH.
parameters.name: token_bought

parameters.description: Only trades at or after this time (UTC if no zone).
parameters.name: after

parameters.description: Only trades at or before this time (UTC if no zone).
parameters.name: before

parameters.description: Every trade, or only ones that went through or failed.
parameters.name: outcome

parameters.description: How many trades to return, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: limit

aggregator.description: The aggregator that routed it; empty for direct trades.

get_routing_flows.description: See where trades are handed from one interface to another, largest first: for example how much volume regular wallets send into a given router. Filter either end by part of its name.
get_routing_flows.name: get_routing_flows

parameters.description: Only flows starting at a name containing this.
parameters.name: source

parameters.description: Only flows ending at a name containing this.
parameters.name: target

parameters.description: How many flows to return, from 1 to 500. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

get_sandwich_attacks.description: Get the biggest sandwich attacks of the last 7 days, where a bot trades just before and after someone to profit from their trade, with the victim's wallet and trade size and the week's totals. Weekly totals count victims trading at least $1,000.
get_sandwich_attacks.name: get_sandwich_attacks

parameters.description: One chain, or all four.
parameters.name: chain

parameters.description: Only attacks on this exchange. Leave empty for any.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Only attacks where the victim's trade was at least this many US dollars. Leave empty for any size.
parameters.name: min_victim_usd

parameters.description: How many attacks to return, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

attacks_7d.description: Attacks in the last 7 days, all chains.

sandwiched_usd_7d.description: Dollars sandwiched in the last 7 days.

top_pair_share_pct.description: Share of the week's attacks on that one pair. Above 50, the total mostly describes one pool.

victim_floor_usd.description: Smallest victim trade the weekly totals count.

get_volume_by_source.description: See which apps, routers and contracts send the most exchange volume, largest first, split by how it was routed. This is ClearTrace's main attribution table.
get_volume_by_source.name: get_volume_by_source

parameters.description: One chain, or all four.
parameters.name: chain

parameters.description: Only sources whose name contains this, such as 1inch.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: How many sources to return, from 1 to 1000. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many rows to skip first, to page through a long list. Leave at 0 for the top of the list.
parameters.name: skip

aggregator_partner_volume_usd.description: Aggregator volume tagged with a partner code.

calldata_suffix_volume_usd.description: Volume carrying a frontend's tag. An overlay: already counted in the total, so don't add it on.

direct_volume_usd.description: Volume sent straight to exchange pools.

fee_transfer_volume_usd.description: Volume where a fee was paid on to this address. An overlay: already counted in the total, so don't add it on.

proxy_volume_usd.description: Volume that went through an unverified proxy first.

total_volume_usd.description: All DEX volume traced through it, in US dollars.

list_contract_labels.description: List the busy contracts ClearTrace has profiled, with the name it found for each where it found one, what kind of contract it is and how sure it is.
list_contract_labels.name: list_contract_labels

parameters.description: One chain, or all four.
parameters.name: chain

parameters.description: How many contracts to return, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many rows to skip first, to page through a long list. Leave at 0 for the top of the list.
parameters.name: skip

entity_type.description: token, router_or_proxy, contract, eoa or delegated_eoa.

label.description: Its name, when one was found.

look_up_trade.description: Look up one trade by its transaction hash and find out which app, router or aggregator it came through and how ClearTrace knows, plus the pools it touched, any fees skimmed off it and whether it was sandwiched. A block explorer link to the transaction works in place of the hash.
look_up_trade.display_name: Look up where a trade came from
look_up_trade.display_str_template: Look up where trade {0} came from.
look_up_trade.name: look_up_trade

parameters.description: The trade's transaction hash (0x and 64 characters), or a block explorer link to it.
parameters.name: tx_hash

parameters.description: The chain the trade happened on.
parameters.name: chain

parameters.description: Add a rough dollar size for the trade, from today's spot price. Slower, and never a settlement figure.
parameters.name: estimate_usd

parameters.description: Look inside the transaction's internal calls to catch an aggregator hidden behind another contract. Slower; works best on Ethereum.
parameters.name: use_traces

raw_amount.description: Exact amount in the token's smallest unit.

frontend_name.description: The app it came from, when ClearTrace is sure.

frontend_type.description: named_frontend, aggregator_api_direct, wallet_embedded, bots_mev or unattributed.

primary_vector.description: The main way it was routed: proxy, aggregator, fee_recipient, calldata_suffix, direct or unclassified.

rank_exchanges.description: Rank decentralised exchanges and aggregators by how close their trades land to the market price, best first. Each gets a Slippage Score from 0 to 100 and the number of trades it is based on. Exchanges with fewer than 1,000 trades are left out.
rank_exchanges.name: rank_exchanges

parameters.description: Rank on one chain, or blend all four. Scores differ by chain, so pick one to compare like with like.
parameters.name: chain

parameters.description: How many exchanges to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.
parameters.name: limit

dispersion_ratio.description: How much bigger the typical gap is than the signed one. Near 1 means the gap is a real cost; large means it is mostly noise.

median_slippage_bps.description: Typical gap from the market price, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

pct_trades_paid.description: Share of trades where the trader paid, in percent.

signed_median_bps.description: The same gap with its sign: positive when traders pay, negative when they gain.

slippage_direction.description: cost when traders pay on balance, gain when they gain.

total_protocols.description: How many exchanges are scored in all.

description: Neutral data on how well decentralised exchanges execute trades on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Optimism. Rank exchanges by slippage, find out which app or router a trade came through, track sandwich attacks and failed-transaction rates, see where volume flows, profile any address and check live gas prices. Free and open, no account needed.
